data.name: Query_SelectAll_WithPaging_WithOtherTables
data.value: SELECT AR_SET_Tax.CompanyID, AR_SET_Tax.PeriodID, AR_SET_Tax.TaxID, AR_SET_Tax.TaxName, AR_SET_Tax.Description, AR_SET_Tax.TaxTypeID, SET_TaxType.TaxTypeName, AR_SET_Tax.TaxRate, AR_SET_Tax.TaxRecoveryRate, AR_SET_Tax.TaxRecoverRuleID, SET_TaxRecoverRule.TaxRecoverRuleName, AR_SET_Tax.TaxCCID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail.Description AS CCDescription, AR_SET_Tax.OffSetTaxCCID, GL_CodeCombinationDetail_1.Description AS OffSetDescription, AR_SET_Tax.StartDate, AR_SET_Tax.InActiveDate, AR_SET_Tax.EnabledFlag, AR_SET_Tax.Status, AR_SET_Tax.CreatedBy, AR_SET_Tax.CreateDate, AR_SET_Tax.UpdatedBy, AR_SET_Tax.UpdateDate, AR_SET_Tax.CreatedByValue, AR_SET_Tax.UpdatedByValue, ROW_NUMBER() Over (Order by AR_SET_Tax.CompanyID, AR_SET_Tax.PeriodID, AR_SET_Tax.TaxID) as 'Row' FROM AR_SET_Tax INNER JOIN SET_TaxType ON AR_SET_Tax.TaxTypeID = SET_TaxType.TaxTypeID LEFT JOIN SET_TaxRecoverRule ON AR_SET_Tax.TaxRecoverRuleID = SET_TaxRecoverRule.TaxRecoverRuleID LEFT JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail ON --AR_SET_Tax.CompanyID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CompanyID AND AR_SET_Tax.TaxCCID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID LEFT JOIN GL_CodeCombinationDetail AS GL_CodeCombinationDetail_1 ON AR_SET_Tax.OffSetTaxCCID = GL_CodeCombinationDetail_1.CodeCombinationID

data.name: TMS_CountAttendenceReport
data.value:
Select CompanyID, PersonID, EmployeeCode, FullName, DesignationName, DepartmentName, ShiftName, Month_Name, --sum(CountLeave) as Days_Leave, sum(CountPresent) as CountPresent, --sum(CountLeave) + sum(CountPresent) + sum(CountAbsent) as NoofDay, --sum(CountInLate) as Days_Late, --sum(CountOutEarly) as Days_Early, (sELECT DATEDIFF(day, @FromDate, @ToDate)) NoofDay
from ( SELECT distinct fintab.TheDate, convert(varchar(2),TheDate,106)as NewDate, case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then fintab.DayDescription else datename(dw,fintab.TheDate) end as Day_Name, fintab.CompanyID, fintab.PersonID, EmployeeCode, FullName, DesignationName, DepartmentName, ShiftName, datename(month,fintab.TheDate) Month_Name, --case when max(LeavesCount)>0 then 'L' --else -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 'P' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else 'A' end --end --as Status,
--case when count(LR.LeaverequestID) > 0 then -- case when MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) is not null then MAX(PT.[Abbreviation]) else 'L' end --else -- case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 and fintab.Description = 'Sunday' and MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null and MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null then 'W/O' -- when fintab.Reason != '' then 'G.H' -- when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 'P' -- when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 'P' -- else -- 'A' -- end --end as [Status],
--max(LeavesCount) as CountLeave,
case when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 1 else case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) is not null then 1 when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is not null then 1 else 0 end end as CountPresent, --case -- when fintab.IsHoliday = 1 then 0 else -- Case when (MIN(TMSTimeIN) is null AND MAX(TMSTimeOUT) is null) --AND max(fintab.LeavesCount)=0 -- then 1 else 0 end --end as CountAbsent,
case when MIN(TMSTimeIN) > STimeIN then 1 else 0 end CountInLate, case when MAX(TMSTimeOUT) < STimeOUT then 1 else 0 end CountOutEarly
from (
SELECT SET_DateTime.Reason, SET_DateTime.Description,EP.FK_SectionID,EP.FK_LocationID,SET_DateTime.TheDate,EP.JoiningDate, EP.CompanyID,EP.PersonID,EP.EmployeeCode,EP.FullName,EP.FatherName,ED.DesignationName AS DesignationName,DP.DepartmentName AS DepartmentName, SET_DateTime.[Description] as DayDescription, ETMS1.CHECKTIME as TMSTimeIN,ETMS1.CHECKTIME as TMSTimeOUT,SS.[Description] as ShiftName,ETMS1.SENSORID as IsHoliday, --(Select case when count(LR.LeaveRequestID) >0 then 1 else 0 end -- from HRMS_LeaveRequest LR where -- LR.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = EP.PersonID -- and LR.FromDate <= ETMS1.CHECKTIME and LR.ToDate >= ETMS2.CHECKTIME -- and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1) as LeavesCount,
--case when ETMS1.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS1.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS1.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeIN, --case when ETMS2.[ManagementCode]='0' AND ETMS2.[TerminalNo]='0' AND ETMS2.[RawData]='M' then '*' else '' end DataTypeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) ,101) as ShiftTimeOUT,
--CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeIN],114) -- ,101) as STimeIN, --CONVERT(datetime, -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + -- CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUT],114) --,101) as STimeOUT,
CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeINGrace],114) ,101) as STimeIN, CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, SET_DateTime.TheDate)) + ' ' + CONVERT(varchar(100),SS.[TimeOUTGrace],114) ,101) as STimeOUT
--ETMS1.TerminalNo
from SET_DateTime
inner join HRMS_Set_Employee EP on (EP.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null)
and EP.Status=1 and EP.IsActive = 1 left JOIN SET_Designation ED ON ED.DesignationID = EP.FK_JobDesignationID AND ED.IsActive = 1 AND ED.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_Department DP ON DP.DepartmentID = EP.FK_DepartmentID AND DP.IsActive = 1 AND DP.Status = 1
left JOIN HRMS_EmployeeShift ES on ( ES.FromDate <= SET_DateTime.TheDate AND ES.ToDate >= SET_DateTime.TheDate) and ES.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ES.Status=1 left JOIN HRMS_Set_Shift SS on SS.ShiftID = ES.ShiftID and SS.Status=1
left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS1 on TMS1.StatusID=1 and TMS1.Status=1 -- Min left JOIN HRMS_TMS_Status TMS2 on TMS2.StatusID=2 and TMS2.Status=1 -- Max
--left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS1 on ETMS1.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS1.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS1.StatusCode=TMS1.StatusCode and left join Hrms_CheckInOut ETMS1 on cast(ETMS1.USERID as Varchar(10)) = EP.EmployeeCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS1.CHECKTIME)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS1.CHECKTIME)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS1.CHECKTIME)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate
--left join HRMS_TMSData ETMS2 on ETMS2.CompanyID = EP.CompanyID and ETMS2.PersonID = EP.PersonID and ETMS2.StatusCode=TMS2.StatusCode and left join Hrms_CheckInOut ETMS2 on cast(ETMS2.USERID as Varchar(10)) = EP.EmployeeCode and CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(mm, ETMS2.CHECKTIME)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(2), DATEPART(dd, ETMS2.CHECKTIME)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar(4), DATEPART(year, ETMS2.CHECKTIME)) ,101) = SET_DateTime.TheDate where --SET_DateTime.TheDate >= @FromDate and SET_DateTime.TheDate <= @ToDate ETMS2.CHECKTIME BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} {1}
) as fintab
left join HRMS_LeaveRequest LR on LR.CompanyID = fintab.CompanyID and LR.FK_PersonID = fintab.PersonID and LR.FromDate <= fintab.TheDate and LR.ToDate >= fintab.TheDate and LR.[Status]=1 and LR.[IsApproved]=1
left join HRMS_PayrollType PT on PT.PayrollTypeID=LR.FK_PayrollTypeID and PT.PayrollTypeCode=LR.FK_PayrollTypeCode and PT.[Status]=1
left join Set_Section on Set_Section.SectionID = fintab.FK_SectionID and Set_Section.Status =1
left join SET_Location on SET_Location.LocationID = fintab.FK_LocationID and SET_Location.Status =1
group by TheDate, fintab.CompanyID, fintab.PersonID, EmployeeCode, FullName, DesignationName, DepartmentName, IsHoliday, fintab.DayDescription, ShiftName, STimeIN, STimeOUT, --fintab.TerminalNo, fintab.JoiningDate, fintab.Description , fintab.Reason
) TAB
Group by CompanyID, PersonID, EmployeeCode, FullName, DesignationName, DepartmentName, ShiftName, Month_Name Order by EmployeeCode

data.name: TMS_Sheikhoo
data.value: select Hrms_CheckInOut.USERID as PersonID, hrms_set_employee.FullName, Hrms_CheckInOut.CHECKTIME as TMSDateTime, Hrms_CheckInOut.Memoinfo as MachineIP, Hrms_CheckInOut.WorkCode as MachinePort, Hrms_CheckInOut.SENSORID as MachineNumber from Hrms_CheckInOut inner join hrms_set_employee on Hrms_set_employee.EmployeeCode =cast(Hrms_CheckInOut.USERID as Varchar(10)) and hrms_set_employee.Status = 1 where Cast(Hrms_CheckInOut.CHECKTIME as Date) between @FromDate and @ToDate and hrms_set_employee.CompanyID in (@CompanyID) and hrms_set_employee.Status= 1 and hrms_set_employee.IsActive = 1 {0} {1} order by Hrms_CheckInOut.CHECKTIME desc
